title: Show a Proposal
description: Reads one saved Proposal or Draft by id, with its status, label, Rationale, Comments and operations; --current adds the value each change's field holds now, and an Applied Proposal carries its appliedRecord: the effects and evidence counts Apply saved. In JSON Comments, missing findings means unchecked, [] means checked and clean, and a non-empty array lists findings. It returns the first 10 operations and names the next offset; --limit, --offset, --page and --all read the rest. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
